warnings: House title block: 'ภัทรวรรณ' (Phattharawan), แบบบ้านยิ้มเพื่อประชาชน (ตามนโยบาย ม.ร.ว. สุขุมพันธุ์ บริพัตร, ผู้ว่าราชการกรุงเทพมหานคร, โดยสำนักการโยธา กรุงเทพมหานคร), design donated by บริษัท แลนดี้ โฮม (ประเทศไทย) จำกัด — same donated-design program as house #29 (บ้านสกาวรัตน์, also TYPE M) but a different named design. Sheets carry no S-xx code system (sheet_code null throughout) and no drawing-set index/TOC page; structural sheets were located by paging through the set (หน้า19-หน้า27, all titled 'ผังโครงสร้าง.../SECTION...' directly).

x_lines resolved from the footing plan (หน้า19) printed chain: edge(1.30)-1-3.00-2-5.00-3-2.40-4-3.60-5-3.00-6, total 17.00 (1 to 6) cross-checks exactly against the printed total. y_lines from the same sheet: A-4.00-B-1.00-C-2.00-D-2.00-E-4.00-F, total 13.00 (A to F) cross-checks exactly.

Dummy grids 2' (pos_m 4.30) and 2'' (pos_m 6.70) resolve two small footings (F1 mark) printed on row A between grid 2 and grid 3, each offset 1.30 m from its named neighbour (2'=grid2+1.30, 2''=grid3-1.30) — likely footings for a small bay/dormer projection above the 'ทำงาน' room seen on the architectural floor plan (หน้า03). Both piles are counted in the F1 pile-count note, see plan_footing warnings.

Dummy grid 1' (pos_m -1.30, before the x origin, per the schema's own negative-pos_m precedent) and dummy grid A' (pos_m 2.60, between A and B) resolve the ground-floor bow/bay-window structure at the building's NW corner (หน้า19/หน้า20): a chamfered footing/beam path runs A1 -> (1',A') -> (1',B) -> C1 -> C2. All four corner pile counts (F1 x4 additional occurrences) reconcile exactly against the handwritten pile-count note on หน้า19 (F1=11, F1A=9, F2=4 total 24 footings, all match the grid_refs enumerated in plan_footing).

The upper-floor beam plan (หน้า21) and the roof structural plan (หน้า22) both show a LARGER bow/bay-window turret at the same NW corner, projecting further out than the ground-floor footprint (an upper-floor cantilevered bay, consistent with the architectural floor plans). Its exact facet coordinates were not independently re-derived into new dummy grid lines within the time available for this house — elements on that turret (หน้า21/หน้า22) use approximate '~' grid_refs anchored to the nearest resolved point (1',A ) rather than invented precise dummy positions; flagged at lower confidence on those specific elements rather than silently guessed, matching the precedent set by house #29's bay-window plan_beam files.

Additional small sub-bay dimension ticks appear on the beam plans (หน้า20: 0.70 near grid3, 1.70/1.90/1.00 near grid4; หน้า21: 2.80 near grid3) that were not resolved to new dummy grid lines — no clear beam endpoint was confidently traced to justify a new dummy within the time available, so these are recorded in unassigned_dimensions rather than invented as grid points, per the beam-endpoint rule (only add a dummy when a beam/footing endpoint actually needs it).

z_levels left empty: this house's structural sheets print no named building-wide reference level (no 'ระดับพื้นชั้น1'-style label on any Pass-2 sheet) — every level encountered is either a per-beam soffit offset printed directly on the beam mark (e.g. 'B1(+0.40)') or a per-slab-marker offset, both recorded on the element's own level_m field rather than in this registry, matching the treatment used for house #29 (same drawing series).
